alt.en: A small printed book page headed "Psalms. 253". Under the end of another hymn and an italic note, it reads "Psalm XCVIII. Second Part. The Messiah's Coming and Kingdom", followed by four numbered verses beginning "Joy to the World; the Lord is come", printed with the old long s.
alt.es: Página impresa de un libro pequeño con el encabezado "Psalms. 253". Bajo el final de otro himno y una nota en cursiva se lee "Psalm XCVIII. Second Part. The Messiah's Coming and Kingdom", seguido de cuatro estrofas numeradas que empiezan "Joy to the World; the Lord is come", impresas con la antigua s larga.

caption.en: Watts's Psalm 98, second part, headed "The Messiah's Coming and Kingdom", on page 253 of The Psalms of David Imitated (London, 1719), the words' earliest known printing, with his note on the two hymns he made from the psalm.
caption.es: El Salmo 98, segunda parte, de Watts, con el título "The Messiah's Coming and Kingdom", en la página 253 de The Psalms of David Imitated (Londres, 1719), la primera impresión conocida de la letra, con su nota sobre los dos himnos que sacó del salmo.

source: Isaac Watts, The Psalms of David Imitated in the Language of the New Testament (London: J. Clark, R. Ford and R. Cruttenden, 1719), p. 253
library: Princeton Theological Seminary Library (digitized by the Internet Archive)
licenceEvidence: Printed London 1719; Isaac Watts 1674-1748 (Internet Archive record). Faithful scan of a flat page adds no new copyright (see rights.md).
credit: Princeton Theological Seminary Library, via the Internet Archive

alt.en: A wide printed page of music numbered 70, headed "No. 73. Antioch. C. M. Arranged from Handel." and "Ch. Ps. Ps. 98, 2d pt.", in four parts on four staves in A major and 2/4 time, with the first and third verses under the notes and verses 2 to 4 printed at the lower right.
alt.es: Página ancha de música impresa con el número 70 y el encabezado "No. 73. Antioch. C. M. Arranged from Handel." y "Ch. Ps. Ps. 98, 2d pt.", a cuatro voces en cuatro pentagramas, en La mayor y en 2/4, con la primera y la tercera estrofa bajo las notas y las estrofas 2 a 4 impresas abajo a la derecha.

caption.en: The tune as Lowell Mason named it ANTIOCH in 1836, No. 73 in his Occasional Psalm and Hymn Tunes (Boston), marked "Arranged from Handel" and set to Watts's Psalm 98, second part.
caption.es: La melodía cuando Lowell Mason la llamó ANTIOCH en 1836, n.º 73 de sus Occasional Psalm and Hymn Tunes (Boston), con la indicación "Arranged from Handel" y la letra del Salmo 98, segunda parte, de Watts.

source: Lowell Mason, Occasional Psalm and Hymn Tunes, No. 3 (Boston: J. H. Wilkins & R. B. Carter; entered for copyright 1836, catalogued as 1837), No. 73, p. 70, "Antioch. C. M."
library: Boston Public Library (digitized by the Internet Archive)
licenceEvidence: "Entered according to Act of Congress, in the year 1836" (the book's own notice); Lowell Mason 1792-1872 (Internet Archive record). Faithful scan of a flat page (see rights.md).
credit: Boston Public Library, via the Internet Archive

alt.en: A wide printed page of music numbered 132, headed "Antioch. C. M." and "Arranged from Handel", in four parts in E-flat major with "Joy to the world, the Lord is come!" under the notes, a second hymn tune called Warren at the lower right, and a footnote in italics along the bottom.
alt.es: Página ancha de música impresa con el número 132 y el encabezado "Antioch. C. M." y "Arranged from Handel", a cuatro voces en Mi bemol mayor con "Joy to the world, the Lord is come!" bajo las notas, otra melodía de himno llamada Warren abajo a la derecha y una nota en cursiva al pie.

caption.en: ANTIOCH on page 132 of Mason and Webb's National Psalmist (Boston, 1848), the four parts our arrangement is read from, with Mason's footnote that the tune is best kept to "Choir and Singing School practice".
caption.es: ANTIOCH en la página 132 de The National Psalmist de Mason y Webb (Boston, 1848), las cuatro voces de las que parte nuestro arreglo, con la nota de Mason de que la melodía conviene sobre todo para "Choir and Singing School practice", los ensayos de coro y las escuelas de canto.

source: Lowell Mason and George James Webb, The National Psalmist (Boston: Tappan, Whittemore, and Mason, 1848), p. 132, "Antioch. C. M."
library: Boston Public Library (digitized by the Internet Archive)
licenceEvidence: Published Boston 1848; Lowell Mason 1792-1872, George James Webb 1803-1887 (Internet Archive record). Faithful scan of a flat page (see rights.md).
